Multi Box 3.1.4

• New Overview interface with violet accents, searchable preview cards and clear settings.
• Integrated window controls and mouse-wheel scrolling across the preview dashboard.
• Change DWM or Capture for existing previews from the inspector.
• Crop handles, move and keyboard controls, image refresh and preview-size preservation.
• Removed Session apps; saved workspaces and source reconnection remain available.
• Retains transparent floating labels, independent duplicate mouse settings,
  existing performance improvements, Gumroad activation and update checks.
